messages:
Jordan M: Heads-up: NovusCare wants a 7-day POC. Requirements: IdP-initiated SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning with incremental deltas, AD group -> role sync, multi-domain locking for model access, and the ability to allowlist SCIM callback IPs. Also will need answers for security questionnaire around signed assertions, KMS, and audit retention. Can we confirm what's feasible for the POC? cc @Tessa H @Ravi P

Tessa H: We support IdP-initiated SAML. We validate signatures, audience, recipient, and can request specific authnContext. SAML metadata endpoint: https://meta.redwood.ai/saml/metadata — share with their IdP team.

Ravi P: SCIM 2.0 supported. Endpoints: /Users (GET/POST/PATCH), bulk import is supported but for POC recommend incremental PATCH flows with If-Modified-Since / ETag to avoid full reprovisioning. For very high delta volumes (>50k changes/day) we need a performance add-on.

Jordan M: They also want AD groups preserved (external GUIDs) mapped to our roles. Any pitfalls?

Ravi P: We map group GUID -> role binding. Edge-case: if IdP rotates GUIDs you can get temporary mismatches. We run a 4-minute reconciliation job and apply idempotent role binds; will document reconciliation behavior and conflict window.

Tessa H: Domain controls: we require domain ownership proof. Preferred: DNS TXT at domain apex. If they only control subdomains, we accept TXT at subdomain or a CNAME-based delegation. Will include examples in onboarding checklist.

Jordan M: Legal asked: "Do you support customer-managed KMS for service account keys and HSM?" Also: "Audit log retention options?"

SecurityBot: Hosted: support CMKs via partner KMS integrations (BYOK available in enterprise contract). Dedicated/Private: BYOK/HSM supported. Default audit retention 90 days; enterprise can request 12 months or archive exports to their storage for arbitrary retention.

Jordan M: SCIM callback allowlist: can we give them fixed IPs to allowlist during POC?

OpsBot: For Dedicated: yes, static egress IPs/VPC egress available. For Hosted: we publish stable CIDR ranges but not guaranteed single IP per callback. Alternative: we can run a temporary connector inside their VPC (inbound) or set up VPC peering for the POC. Note: mTLS for SCIM is possible but needs a small engineering task (3-5 business days) — can be scoped if needed.

Tessa H: Pricing note: Hosted counts SCIM under admin API request units (small per-request charge). Dedicated includes control-plane in reservation; extreme scale syncs are an add-on. Ask NovusCare for projected active users and daily delta counts.

Jordan M: Action items: 1) Jordan - ask NovusCare for expected user base + daily delta rate. 2) Tessa - send SAML metadata + sample SSO failure modes. 3) Ravi - prepare SCIM example payloads, delta guidance, and reconciliation note. 4) SecurityBot - prep KMS + retention blurb for questionnaire. 5) OpsBot - provide CIDR list and Dedicated egress options, note on mTLS timeline. I'll compile and send pre-POC checklist.

Jordan M: Created ticket POC-9021 (owner: Jordan M). Will update when NovusCare replies. Thanks all :thumbsup:
